title.value: A stochastic integer programming approach to reserve staff scheduling with preferences
title.justification: The provided text clearly mentions the title at the beginning.
title.quote:
A stochastic integer programming approach to reserve staff scheduling with preferences

arXiv:2210.04808v1 [math.OC] 10 Oct 2022

extractions.description: The paper presents a stochastic integer programming approach to solve reserve staff scheduling problems, incorporating employee preferences to improve satisfaction and reduce absenteeism in the transit industry. It formulates a two-stage stochastic integer program with mixed-integer recourse, focusing on the scheduling of reserve employees to cover unknown absences, considering both exogenous and endogenous uncertainties.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on improving employee scheduling within the transit industry, focusing on reducing absenteeism and improving employee satisfaction. Climate Change is not a central theme throughout the paper.
climate_change_is_central.quote: Our contributions summarize as follows. First, we formulate a two-stage stochastic integer program with mixed-integer recourse to model the XB days-off scheduling problem over a finite time horizon.
